title: Identification of SET/EED dual binders as innovative PRC2 inhibitors.
authors: Catalano, Raffaella; Maruca, Annalisa; Rocca, Roberta; Tassone, Pierfrancesco; Panzarella, Giulia; Costa, Giosue; Ortuso, Francesco; Alcaro, Stefano
one_liner_zh: 该文通过药效团和对接虚拟筛选寻找PRC2双靶抑制剂，涉及蛋白-小分子互作，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Background: The inhibition of PRC2, implicated in the pathogenesis of several tumors, can be a useful therapeutic strategy for cancer treatment. In the literature, two types of PRC2 modulators are reported: competitive inhibitors of S-adenosyl methionine binding to the catalytic subunit EZH2; and allosteric ligands that prevent the interaction of the trimethylated H3K27 lysine in histone 3 to the EED subunit. The lack of dual EZH2/EED modulators drove us to search for compounds capable of recognizing both domains. Materials & methods: This goal was pursued by combining pharmacophore- and docking-based virtual screening of the Multi-Target Ligand Chemotheca database. Prediction tools for absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion and pan-assay interference compounds were also applied. Results: Finally, five 1,2,3-triazole derivatives were identified as promising dual EZH2/EED modulators. Conclusion: Our multistage screening protocol highlighted the great potential of Chemotheca for identifying polypharmacological agents.
abstract_zh: 背景：PRC2的抑制与多种肿瘤的发病机制相关，可成为癌症治疗的有效策略。文献中报道了两类PRC2调节剂：竞争性抑制剂，作用于S-腺苷甲硫氨酸与催化亚基EZH2的结合；以及变构配体，阻止组蛋白3中三甲基化H3K27赖氨酸与EED亚基的相互作用。缺乏双重EZH2/EED调节剂促使我们寻找能够同时识别这两个结构域的化合物。材料与方法：通过结合药效团和基于对接的虚拟筛选，对Multi-Target Ligand Chemotheca数据库进行筛选以实现此目标。同时应用了吸收、分布、代谢和排泄预测工具以及泛分析干扰化合物预测工具。结果：最终，五个1,2,3-三唑衍生物被鉴定为有前景的双重EZH2/EED调节剂。结论：我们的多阶段筛选方案突显了Chemotheca在识别多药理学药物方面的巨大潜力。
